```{r}
# write.table(sub_data,"subdata.csv",row.names=FALSE,col.names=TRUE,sep=",")
sub_data<-read.csv("subdata.csv",as.is = TRUE, encoding = 'UTF-8')


# not in function
'%!in%' <- function(x,y)!('%in%'(x,y))

# this is the function to do the boostrap resampling
boosting_yield <- function (sdata, term, treatment) {
  k = n_rep
  # n_sample: set it equals to the original sample size
  mysamples = replicate(k, sample(sdata$yi, replace=T))
  mymeans = apply(mysamples, 2, mean, na.rm = T)
  
  # quantile
  BootsTest <- quantile(mymeans,c(0.025, 0.50, 0.975))
  Boots_outputs <- tibble(term, treatment, (exp(BootsTest[[1]])-1)*100, (exp(BootsTest[[2]])-1)*100
                          , (exp(BootsTest[[3]])-1)*100, nrow(sdata), unique(sdata$StudyID) %>% length )
  colnames(Boots_outputs) <- c("Term", "Treatment", "Low", "Mean", "High", "obs", "n_study")
  return(Boots_outputs)
}

```




```{r}
set.seed(1234567)
n_rep <- 10000

# All data
## aggregate first ## updated for revision
sub_data %>% 
  dplyr::select(StudyID, ExperimentID, Top_Climate, TextureGroup, ConservationGroup, CoverCropGroup, GrainCropGroup, yi) %>% 
  group_by(StudyID, ExperimentID, Top_Climate, TextureGroup, ConservationGroup, CoverCropGroup, GrainCropGroup) %>% 
  summarise(yi = mean(yi)) -> sum_all 

boots_outputs <- boosting_yield(sum_all, "All data", "All")
boosting_yield(sub_data, "All data", "All")

# by climate
boots_outputs <- bind_rows(boots_outputs, boosting_yield(subset(sum_all, Top_Climate == "Tropic"), "Climate", "Tropic"))
boots_outputs <- bind_rows(boots_outputs, boosting_yield(subset(sum_all, Top_Climate == "Arid"), "Climate", "Arid"))
boots_outputs <- bind_rows(boots_outputs, boosting_yield(subset(sum_all, Top_Climate == "Temperate"), "Climate", "Temperate"))
```

```{r}
# BiomassCash
data_all_select %>% dplyr::select(StudyID, ExperimentID, Top_Climate, TextureGroup, ConservationGroup, CoverCropGroup, GrainCropGroup, x_BiomassCash, yi)  %>% 
  subset(yi!="NA", na.rm=TRUE)%>% 
  subset(x_BiomassCash!="NA", na.rm=TRUE) -> sum_BiomassCash
sum_BiomassCash %>% group_by(StudyID, ExperimentID, Top_Climate, TextureGroup, ConservationGroup, CoverCropGroup, GrainCropGroup) %>%
  summarise(yi = mean(yi)) -> yi_Group 
sum_BiomassCash %>% group_by(StudyID, ExperimentID, Top_Climate, TextureGroup, ConservationGroup, CoverCropGroup, GrainCropGroup) %>%
  summarise(x_BiomassCash = mean(x_BiomassCash))  -> BiomassCash_Group
yi_BiomassCash_Group <- list(BiomassCash_Group, yi_Group)
Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, all=TRUE), yi_BiomassCash_Group) -> yi_BiomassCash
with(yi_BiomassCash,tapply(Top_Climate,list(Top_Climate),length))
with(yi_BiomassCash,tapply(TextureGroup,list(TextureGroup),length))
with(yi_BiomassCash,tapply(ConservationGroup,list(ConservationGroup),length))
with(yi_BiomassCash,tapply(CoverCropGroup,list(CoverCropGroup),length))
with(yi_BiomassCash,tapply(GrainCropGroup,list(GrainCropGroup),length))

n_total <- nrow(yi_BiomassCash)
n_study <- length(unique(yi_BiomassCash$StudyID))
fit <- lm(yi_BiomassCash$yi ~ yi_BiomassCash$x_BiomassCash)
summary(fit)
intercept_a <- summary(fit)$coefficients[1,1] %>% round(6)
try_slope_b <- try(summary(fit)$coefficients[2,1]) 
        if (is(try_slope_b, "try-error")) {slope_b <- NA} else(slope_b <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2,1] %>% round(6))
        if (is(try_slope_b, "try-error")) {p_slope_b <- NA} else(p_slope_b <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2,4] %>% round(6))
fit_R2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared %>% round(6)
fit_yi_BiomassCash <- data.frame(n_total, n_study, intercept_a, slope_b, p_slope_b, fit_R2)

        if (is(try_slope_b, "try-error")) {p_slope_b <- NA} else(p_slope_b <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2,4] %>% round(6))
fit_R2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared %>% round(6)
fit_Temperate_MBN <- data.frame(n_total, n_study, intercept_a, slope_b, p_slope_b, fit_R2)
```
